resources.string: Your phone, a second microphone.\n\nAudio travels through the cable to Quipus. Start and stop the meeting on your recorder after everyone agrees. This app has no internet access and does not save audio on your phone.
Connect Quipus with a USB-C data cable.
USB access declined. Quipus can still use its onboard microphone.
No compatible Quipus USB connection found. Use a data cable and phone-audio firmware.
Waiting for Quipus to start a consented meeting.
Connected. Start the meeting on Quipus after consent.
Phone microphone disconnected. Quipus continues with its onboard microphone.
Meeting stopped. Quipus is saving both recordings.
Recording through USB. Stop the meeting on Quipus.
Phone audio interrupted. Quipus keeps its onboard recording.
